name: Ashur (Qal'at Sherqat)
description: Ashur, also called Qal'at Sherqat, is the ruined capital of the ancient Assyrians, set on a rocky spur above the Tigris in northern Iraq. People lived here for around 3,000 years, and it was the religious heart of the empire, home to temples of the god Ashur and many other deities. Today it is on the List in Danger, threatened by a proposed dam.
